text:
jamie: Heads-up — CI GPU job `tests/longseq` is red on main again, flakey OOM-ish failures but logs show allocation failures around 1.9GB not full GPU kill. Happened 3/5 runs since yesterday.

ci-bot: [CI] tests/longseq — 3 failures out of 5. Failing step: run_inference_cuda (exit code 137 on one run, others raised cudaErrorMemoryAllocation). Artifacts: /artifacts/1801234567/longseq/*.log

taylor: Can you paste the relevant snippet from the test log? Is it the same stacktrace every time or different callsites?

jamie: Here's the repeated section from one of the logs:```
[INFO] Allocating KV cache chunk 2048MB
[ERROR] cudaMalloc returned cudaErrorMemoryAllocation at src/alloc.c:421
[WARN] falling back to guest allocator
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
```

sophia: That looks like fragmentation not total memory. Did we change the allocator settings in the runtime PR (r/482)? IIRC that PR changed small-chunk pooling.

jamie: Yes PR 482 adjusted pool thresholds. I guessed that earlier and reverted locally but couldn't repro on my dev machine (single-step runs fine). CI uses longer concatenated sequences which may trigger fragmentation.

taylor: Can we try rerunning CI with env var to disable the pooling and force big allocations? e.g., set REDWOOD_ALLOC_POOL=0 in the job and rerun only the failing matrix cell.

jamie: Kicking a rerun with REDWOOD_ALLOC_POOL=0 now (requested via CI UI). Will report back.

ci-bot: Rerun queued for job tests/longseq (matrix: cuda-12.1, driver-525).

sre-bot: Note: nodes in gpu-pool-3 were rotated last night, they have driver 525.85.05. If this repros only on rotated nodes it could be a driver/fragmentation interaction.

jamie: Rerun finished: still failed twice of three. When I pulled the full dmesg from the node I see repeated soft errors:```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:af:00): 31, pid=2421, Graphics SM exception on GPC 0: Xid=31 (SCHED_TYPE)
[ 1234.567892] NVRM: GPU memory allocation failed: out of memory
```

sophia: Xid 31 can be noisy, but combined with cudaErrorMemoryAllocation earlier it's consistent. Two parallel ideas: 1) run with REDWOOD_FORCE_COMPACT=1 to force early compaction between allocations; 2) bisect PR 482 to find the exact commit that changed pooling thresholds. Can you try a localized bisect by cherry-picking the allocator commits into a short-lived branch and running the failing test locally in a loop?

jamie: Will try compaction flag first. Also leaving a bisect request — @taylor can you take the git bisect if you're free? I don't want to hold the queue.

taylor: I can take it. Which commit range?

jamie: Range is from 7f3a2b1..b4d9c8e (allocator refactor series). The offending behavior appears after 7f3a2b1.

taylor: Ok starting `git bisect` on that range, but for speed I'll run a minimal repro that runs the model for 800 tokens in a tight loop. Command I'll use:```
for i in {1..50}; do RUNTIME_FLAGS=\"--max-len 800\" ./tools/run_longseq_test.sh || break; done
```

ci-bot: Artifact note: ephemeral CUDA debug logs attached at /artifacts/1801234567/debug.tar.gz

jamie: Quick datapoint — running with REDWOOD_FORCE_COMPACT=1 locally reduced failures to 0/30. So compaction helps. Not a full fix (need CI reproduce), but promising.

taylor: Bisect progress: narrowed to commit b4d9c8e (pooling thresholds change). Quick test on bisect midpoint repros the failure. Marking commit as bad. Will open a revert PR for that single change and request a hotfix CI run.

sophia: Thanks. If revert fixes CI we can reopen a follow-up PR that adjusts thresholds more conservatively, and add a CI job that runs long concatenated sequences with pooling enabled to catch regressions. Also add a small fuzz that toggles REDWOOD_ALLOC_POOL on/off across runs.

jamie: Agree. I'll add the CI matrix change and a note in the release checklist: \"run longseq with pooling on to catch fragmentation\". Also adding a test harness that runs compaction flag combos.

taylor: PR opened: #512 revert pooling threshold change. CI trigger requested.

ci-bot: PR 512 started CI: tests/longseq now queued with revert.

sre-bot: FYI scheduled maintenance on gpu-pool-3 this week, might affect flaky noise. Recommend merging hotfix early if green.

jamie: Great work everyone. Leaving this thread pinned to the channel until revert CI passes. Followups: (1) add longseq to nightly matrix, (2) add config toggle test, (3) postmortem note if revert merged. :thumbsup:

sophia: Also logging issue in tracking board with links to artifacts: INFRA-287.

jamie: Closing initial triage — will update when revert CI completes.
